name: Data
description: Numeric raster layer decoded client-side and colorized/shaded with a WebGL shader on the 2D map (e.g. DEMs, data products).

supportedData.label: Float32 RGBA data tiles
supportedData.description: Templated numeric-data tiles encoding values in RGBA (e.g. float32-packed PNG). Decoded and colorized client-side by a WebGL shader.
supportedData.procurement: Produce data-encoded tiles with the MMGIS auxiliary tiling scripts.

supportedData.label: Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) data
supportedData.description: A single-band data COG tiled by TiTiler as NPY (or terrarium/terrainrgb-encoded PNG) and shaded client-side. Supports band selection, no-data sentinels and colorize/hillshade shaders.
supportedData.procurement: gdal_translate <in> <out>.tif -of COG; requires the TiTiler adjacent server.

supportedData.label: STAC collection (mosaicked data COGs)
supportedData.description: A STAC collection of data COGs mosaicked and served for client-side shading via titiler-pgstac.
supportedData.procurement: Index data COGs into a STAC collection; requires the titiler-pgstac adjacent server.
